The background is a minimalist white wall with a single light switch visible on the right. (2) A framed image of a horned Viking helmet appears at the top center. The three characters look up at it, pointing and talking with high-energy expressions. The woman in the center has her hands clasped under her chin, while the others gesture towards the image. (3) The scene shifts to a second prop: a white, futuristic gun-like object. The participants lean forward, narrowing their eyes and touching their faces in deep thought. The woman on the left points upward as she shouts out a guess. (4) A third prop, a sleek silver sword with a green gem on the hilt, is displayed. The girl in the middle smiles broadly and covers her mouth in surprise, while a purple-haired digital character is edited onto her shoulder. (5) A fourth prop, a mechanical flying machine with birds, is shown. The man on the right reacts instantly, pointing his finger with a confident expression. (6) A close-up of a hand holding a modern smartphone appears in a window. The group engages in a spirited discussion, with the male character eventually leaning closer to the camera to address the audience directly during a promotional segment, gesturing with his hands to emphasize his points.
